_comment: Sessions where Welsh tunes are played, for the Sessions page (sesiynau/). Each: venue, address, town (town_cy if its Welsh name differs), county (a Welsh principal area in English, or "Outside Wales"), lat, lon, day (Monday … Sunday), repeat ("weekly", or "monthly" with nth: 1-4, or -1 for the last), start and end (24-hour "19:00"; end optional), and confirmed (the date someone last checked it's running as listed). Optional: name (the session's own name), from and until (a season), music and music_cy (what's played), link (the session's or venue's page). Check a session again whenever someone writes in about it, and update confirmed.

sessions.name: Noson Lawen: Folk in the Bar
sessions.music: Welsh folk tunes and songs, in the café bar. Free; bring your fiddle, crwth, pibgorn or voice.
sessions.music_cy: Alawon a chaneuon gwerin Cymreig, ym mar y caffi. Am ddim; dewch â'ch ffidil, crwth, pibgorn neu lais.

sessions.music: Welsh folk night: bring an instrument and join in, or come and listen.
sessions.music_cy: Noson werin Gymreig: dewch ag offeryn i ymuno, neu dewch i wrando.

sessions.name: Sesiwn Werin Tŷ Tawe
sessions.music: Welsh tunes and songs, with the odd exception. At Swansea's Welsh-language centre, run by Menter Iaith Abertawe.
sessions.music_cy: Alawon a chaneuon Cymreig, gydag ambell eithriad. Yng nghanolfan Gymraeg Abertawe, dan ofal Menter Iaith Abertawe.
